# Anviora

> Digital Product Passport platform for Indian battery and textile exporters. Automates EU Battery Passport generation, certificate tracking, QR-code verification, and compliance gap detection for manufacturers exporting to Europe.

## Products

- [Battery](/battery): Generate EU-compliant Battery Passports, track BIS certificates, and verify every cell from factory to recycler.
- [Textile](/textile): Track fiber composition, manage sustainability certifications, and generate EU-compliant textile Digital Product Passports.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans for every scale, including a free tier and MSME discount support via the DGFT TRACE scheme.

## Resources

- [Blog](/blog): Insights on battery and textile compliance, EU Battery Regulation, and export requirements for Indian manufacturers.
